peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is a mylar sleeve?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Industrial Gaskets Mylar sleeve is a used to insulate or isolate bolts from dissimilar metal flanges to avoid galvanic corrosion. Mylar has excellent dielectric strength and low water absorbtion.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What kind of material is mylar?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Mylar® polyester film is made of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and manufactured by Mylar® Specialty Films (formerly DuPont Teijin Films™). First, molten polyethylene terephthalate (PET) polymer is extruded onto a chill roll drum to form film.
